0022600209.text: The Spurs (8-2) come into this 11th game of the season on an eight-game winning streak, sitting 1st in the Southwest and 3rd in the West, and they are undefeated on the road at 4-0. The Suns (3-5) are 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 4.5 games back, and have won their last two games. San Antonio will be without Devin Vassell (groin), Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain), while Phoenix will be without Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the Spurs winning the last meeting 101-100 in San Antonio on March 19, 2026.
